description: Nomeclatorul străzilor din Municipiul Craiova is a dataset listed in data.gov.ro, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Primăria Municipiului Craiova. Information on old and new street names in Craiova. Coverage: Primăria Municipiului Craiova. The portal shows the English title as "Nomeclator of streets in Craiova" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Primăria Municipiului Craiova. Its keywords include nomenclator, craiova, strazi. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2015-10-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ro.
